MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of marine and freshwater environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
